name: TodayContract
description: Read-only Today protocol. Host owns chrome; optional standard RemoteViews supply content.

name: TodayProvider
description:
Export this provider with the discovery action and VERSION metadata=1.
Public rows only: callers other than the launcher may query an exported provider.
No module view code executes in the host: custom content uses standard RemoteViews layouts.
Row actions must name an exported activity in your package.

name: WmAgendaView
description:
Shared single-day native Agenda presentation, in logical VGA pixels.
caldll 029144F8 supplies the two text lines; 029143F8/0291BE38 font spacing;
0292085C/0292011C the read-only DAYVIEWSTRIP. No PIM queries or exported tags.
List font roles51/52/57 and the strip's stock-derived seven-point font
(SHCreateSystemFont(0,7,0):7 is point size, not a role) currently share the
supplied regular Android face: list24px, seven-point strip19px at logical192 DPI; final native GDI metrics/face are unverified.
Android font
extents and all-day padding/border are adaptations. Native strip phase and
discrete easing arithmetic are retained; Android dispatch cadence is not
measured WM hardware cadence. The optional native date footer is absent.

name: WmAppIcons
description: Renders launcher icons at physical pixel resolution without changing their bounds.

name: WmApplet
description: Independent WM-style activity using the same window and controls as the host.

name: WmAppointmentEditor
description:
Shared core of the native two-page appointment card (PIMDLG 20006/20044).
Subject/location, grouped start/end and yes/no all-day follow the recovered
field descriptors. Row/label/popup extents are provisional VGA adaptations.
Recurrence, native busy status, sensitivity and caller-owned category values
are shared; attendees remain unfinished. Caller must validate provider capabilities.
Caller owns provider identity, saving, reminder policy and shell commands.
Editor dates use the shared picker range 1900..2999; value() rejects values
outside it, including values set directly through the exposed fields.

name: WmAppointmentReminder
description:
Native appointment25059 relative reminder composite. Owner supplies popups.
Enabled line remains; disabled hides the numeric/unit line. Closed height
follows shared combo font metrics; width split remains provisional VGA geometry. No task absolute date/time reminder.

name: WmAppointmentText
description: Appointment text at the native save boundary; editing retains the raw draft.

name: WmAssets
description:
Cataloged artwork and media, available without a launcher process or provider.
Optional catalogs are streamed once per app/pack generation, then kept immutable.
Missing catalogs yield an empty inventory. Catalogs are bounded4MiB/8192 entries; previews8MiB/4MP.
Native dimensions, names and IDs are preserved; requestedPixels only reduces
the decoded preview. AVI/WAVE and original GIF/JPEG/CUR bytes use open().

name: WmBar
description:
Original 73-color table, title 1FBC4 and softkey 38815D4 region descriptors.
GDI GradientFill endpoint quantization still needs a WinCE runtime comparison.

name: WmBoxSelect
description:
Native BOXSELECT family: short horizontal exclusive/multiple text cells.
Black selected fill and white text follow commctrl paint; 48px cells and
border geometry are provisional logical VGA extents, not measured DLU.
Exclusive selection can be cleared by selecting the selected cell (style10).
Labels and bit ordering are caller-owned; setters never notify.

name: WmBrowserFavoriteForm
description:
browsres dialog4167 field IDs/order, shared controls and literal drafts.
Owner supplies real destinations, the location popup, validation, persistence
and Add/Cancel commands. Field geometry matches the official 480x640 WM6.1 emulator capture.
Destination ordering and owner dialog/button placement remain separate contracts.

name: WmBrowserFavoritesView
description:
WM6.1.4 Favorites:34px rows, tap selection, Open softkey and double tap.
Owner supplies entries, folder navigation, commands and persistence.

name: WmBrowserFolderForm
description: browsres4168 name12339/label12356; field rectangle measured in WM6.1.4.

name: WmBrowserView
description:
Hosted browser client; the owner supplies title, softkeys, menus and lifecycle.
Native IE command IDs come from browsres4096. Web rendering is Android WebView,
not Trident. Address-row geometry and web scrollbars remain provisional.

name: WmBubble
description:
SHPaintBubbleFrame 3856130: white window brush, round corners and asymmetric tail.
VGA corner diameter 36, tail base 52, pen 4. Header SHColor IDs13/14 are
distinct from the LauncherBar style table. Captured GDI body top is25px below tip.

name: WmCalendarAppointmentsOptions
description:
Calendar property page20005. Native IDs, quantity0..99, unit multipliers
and six display bits are preserved. The native7/14 DLU profile supplies the
default coordinates and42px icon cells; narrow widths and large font metrics
expand rows. Caller owns persistence, mail accounts and reminder scheduling.
This view never accesses CalendarProvider or sends meeting requests.

name: WmCalendarDuration
description:
CalendarProvider fixed elapsed duration adaptation, not nominal civil-day
arithmetic across DST. RFC5545 week/day/time forms are supported. The legacy
Android provider form P<n>S is read only; canonical output uses PT<n>S.
Negative/fractional/overflow durations are rejected, not silently truncated.

name: WmCalendarGeneralOptions
description:
Calendar property page20004: native field order, IDs and value contracts.
Caller owns persistence and immediate application. Native applies on commit;
this SDK reports each completed user change. Coordinates use the original
template and the observed7/14 DLU profile; narrow widths and oversized font
metrics expand rows. No CalendarProvider access occurs here.

name: WmCalendarHeader
description:
CALENDAR top ToolbarWindow32 roles from caldll. Source logical VGA height44,
date reservation140(CJK)/160(other), seven32px weekdays; text controls autosize.
Navigation buttons36px, separator12px follow
the native192DPI model; horizontal gaps project native ARM; Android text extents remain adaptations.
The caller owns date selection and popup placement; no PIM access here.

name: WmCalendarPicker
description:
Shared non-platform month dropdown. Caller places and dismisses it.
Font-derived client extent uses the native logical192DPI formula.

name: WmCalendarSymbols
description:
Original outres.192 BITMAP11029; native mask WORDs confirmed in caldll.
RGB red is the native ImageList transparency key. The six32x28 source cells
are the VGA atlas adaptation; native cell width is runtime SM_CXSMICON.
This component does not assert original-device GDI scaling or icon placement.

name: WmCalendarView
description:
Shared DAYVIEW/WEEKVIEW presentation. All coordinates are logical VGA pixels.
caldll 0290F1C4 supplies font measurements; 02903454 supplies the pinned week
header; 0290C5AC supplies density-first lanes. This is not a WinCE control ABI.
The app supplies clipped civil-day records, owns their tags and opens cards.
Native week date-header selection (029041B8) occurs on DOWN; this shared
capacitive control commits on a completed same-column UP instead.
Native GDI metrics, category colors, overflow and drag editing are partial.

name: WmCategoryNameForm
description:
PIMUTIL New Category client; observed WM6.1.4 VGA frame and divider.
Construct/change on the UI thread. Use localizeTree/restyleTree for the complete form;
onWmRestyle alone updates heading/label fonts and heading color, not input styling.
Owner retains its app title and supplies Done/Cancel, validation and persistence.
Exact GDI raster and Korean/OEM geometry are not established by the USA capture.

name: WmCategoryPicker
description:
PIM category checked-list draft. The owner supplies its catalog, New/OK/Cancel
commands and persistence. Android collation/row metrics replace native NLS/GDI.

name: WmChoice
description:
Closed single-selection field. Caller supplies labels and owns the popup.
Frame2/gutter28/down-arrow geometry is provisional; native combo DLU/font
conversion has not been verified. No platform Spinner, ripple or animation.

name: WmClockPanel
description:
Read-only clock bubble body in the launcher's VGA coordinate space.
ROM evidence: shell32/000214FC.c and shellres CLOCK_TOOLTIP.HTM / CLOCK_BATTERY.HTM;
aygshell/03855938.c -> 03867774.c -> 03867740.c and design/korean-font-preprocess.json.
The Korean title's requested weight 700 is preprocessed to 400. Body CSS has no bold.
Host owns the 444px WmPopup, inside-tap consumption and 7000ms timeout.
No calendar query or permission delegation: caller supplies its own appointment text.

name: WmCloseGlyph
description:
Hand-authored outlines after visual inspection of shellres.192.dll 4610/4615.
Both resources have a 46x52 canvas. Their opaque bounds are OK (10,16)-(36,34)
and X (14,16)-(32,34); keep that padding when sizing the title-bar icon.
The O's smooth ellipses replace 1bpp steps; exact GDI pixels are not claimed.
Geometry is also recorded in design/icons/close-glyphs.svg. No font substitution.

name: WmColor
description:
Integer HSB conversion recovered from AYGSHELL 3851D44/3851F2C.
ARM 3851EAC..3851EFC is authoritative: hue arithmetic is not an 8-bit char.

name: WmCommandBar
description:
Native VGA commands [0,180), [300,480); the middle120px belongs to SIP.
Ordinary commands activate on completed UP, menu commands on DOWN.
The reserved centre has no command action; inputMethods binds an editor owner.

name: WmCommandMenu
description:
Logical-window command popup. Root uses the native command-centre anchor.
Child menus retain their parent and open beside its selected row, clamped to
the client area. Child placement/scroll metrics remain Android adaptations.

name: WmContactDetailsView
description:
Owner-ordered contact drafts. Formatting, subcards and persistence belong to the owner.
Text selection follows the theme; the insertion cursor remains platform-owned on min14.

name: WmContactSubcardView
description: Literal Name/Address components; the owner supplies labels and assembles results.

name: WmContactSummaryView
description:
Captured Contacts Summary geometry, with owner-supplied display data.
The owner validates actions and performs calls/messages/opens. Native Notes is a
read-only tab; its separate editing and commit contract belongs to the owner.

name: WmContactsView
description:
Captured native Contacts client with owner-supplied immutable rows.
Native 54px rows and completed single-click opening are evidenced by the
synthetic emulator fixture. No provider, permission or inferred long press.

name: WmControls
description:
Shared logical-VGA controls; immediate GDI selection, no ripple or fade.
Call factories and restyleTree on the UI thread. Restyling does not rebuild views.

name: WmDateField
description:
Nullable, date-only segmented field. The owner owns the dropdown and persistence.
Flat face follows native Contacts; gutter28 and Android font raster remain adaptations.
Arithmetic is proleptic Gregorian; native historical cutover keyboard behavior is not reproduced.

name: WmDateTimeField
description:
Civil date/time composite for native start25055/end25056 roles. Caller owns
popups, persistence and UI-thread callbacks. Width distribution and the4px
gap adapt to available space; they are not measured native DLU geometry.

name: WmDevice
description: Read-only system state; missing services/permissions degrade without prompts.

name: WmDialog
description:
Explicit embedded dialog owner. Native8EAF0 promotes the focused push button
and restores the stored default when focus returns to a non-button control.
Editors keep their own input; this is not a full IsDialogMessage replacement.

name: WmDocumentFolders
description:
DocList dialog13443: New/Rename/Delete plus flat folders. Owner owns every write.
New creates immediately in the owner, then editName starts native-style label editing.
Back cancels only the label edit; it never undoes an already-created folder.

name: WmDocumentProperties
description:
DocList Rename/Move dialog13444 fields; owner supplies real destinations and
metadata, validates on explicit OK and owns persistence/Cancel. No I/O occurs.
Geometry follows the live480-wide Rename/Move capture: heading48, columns
x22/x138, shared44 input rows. Widths flex on smaller surfaces; this Android
adaptation is not an assumed DLU-to-pixel conversion. Hidden native
static1025 and SIPPREF are omitted. Restyling/localizing preserves the draft.

name: WmEditableChoice
description:
Editable candidate field; caller owns candidates, validation and popup.
Frame2/gutter28 match WmChoice; automatic height follows the plain combo font formula.
Use setValue for silent programmatic changes; direct editing reports deltas.

name: WmFontFile
description:
Private immutable TTF/OTF imports. Caller owns the input stream.
Only the launcher's canonical read-only font URI is accepted for resolution.

name: WmFonts
description:
WM font linking: original Tahoma first, selected local face for missing glyphs.
API 14–28 need spans because CustomFallbackBuilder arrived in API 29.

name: WmIconCaption
description:
Icon-list label selection measured by Android Layout, not native GDI metrics.
The owner supplies icon feedback and selection policy; this view only paints
the visible Layout-line rectangle, not raster glyph outlines. All coordinates are local logical pixels.

name: WmIconPolicy
description:
Immutable per-activity adaptive-icon policy, shared by Programs and SDK Start menus.
Blacklist excludes listed activities; whitelist includes only listed activities.
An existing boolean preference without a mode retains the previous all-app behavior.

name: WmIcons
description: Authored status and Today icons. Draws paths at display scale.

name: WmInputDialog
description:
Full-client name-entry dialog; host hides its commands while this owns them.
Native Media template114: existing title, white client, Done/Cancel footer.
Parent surface and decoder remain attached.

name: WmListSettingsPane
description:
Shared list plus right-side command column for Today and Start settings.
Control relationships follow shellres14421; dimensions retain the current
provisional VGA adaptation. At480px the list is296px; extra width goes to
the list while commands retain their VGA size and right-edge alignment.
The owner supplies scrolling, selection, commands and persistence.

name: WmLogo
description: Compatibility logo wrapper: optional pack artwork or a system emoji. No embedded logo paths.

name: WmLunarCalendar
description:
Korean lunar dates supplied by a resource pack; no built-in year table.
Load off the UI thread. The immutable result remains valid after a pack change.
Gregorian civil dates stay the Calendar provider and selection identities.

name: WmMediaLibraryView
description:
Native Media Library client: 46px header, 34px icon rows and text-only selection.
Owner supplies hierarchy and indexing. Populated metadata pages remain subject
to native raster comparison; no system-wide storage permission is implied.

name: WmMediaPlaylistView
description:
Now Playing list. Native empty-screen capture supplies the 46px header and
toolbar. The 34px rows reuse the shared small-icon list metric; populated
native row selection/raster and disabled-toolbar GDI remain unverified.

name: WmMediaPropertiesView
description:
Native Media property order/roles from wmploc1116..1132 and emulator capture.
Values are literal provider metadata. Unknown codec/DRM/rating/play-count data
is omitted; Android decoding information is not a Windows codec engine.

name: WmMediaQueue
description:
Ordered media sources; duplicates are valid. Reordering preserves the current
occurrence. Shuffle walks a permutation rather than repeating random tracks.
The native shuffle/history algorithm has not been recovered. UI-thread owner.

name: WmMediaView
description:
Native portrait player geometry from the 192-DPI WPC skin. The owner supplies
file selection, library and shell commands. Android decoders determine supported formats.
Vendor bitmaps are optional resource-pack assets, never embedded in the SDK.

name: WmMenuItem
description: Immutable command-menu entry. Children are copied at both API boundaries.

name: WmMessageBox
description:
GWES MessageBox adaptation: pack icon64; MB_OK keeps caption OK
without bottom buttons, confirmation adds Yes/No. No outside dismissal. Native builder00045C7C uses
DPI-scaled10px margins and a5/8-screen text cap. VGA geometry/font measurement
here is provisional; this is not the native GDI dialog backend.

name: WmMetrics
description: v1 logical VGA units. Scale the entire surface once; never apply Android sp.

name: WmMonthCalendar
description:
Single-month picker body, distinct from caldll MONTHVIEW.
commctrl03287EAC: centered digits, retained selection, no cell grid,
title-colored weekday labels, trailing gray text and rectangular today marker.
Android metrics, footer wording and regional week arithmetic are adaptations.

name: WmMonthCalendarHeader
description:
SysMonthCal32 title, separate from Calendar's toolbar. Native 192-DPI button
extents and font-cell title formula; Android font metrics are an adaptation.
Commands use completed UP; native DOWN/repeat timer is deliberately not used.

name: WmMonthView
description:
Client-fitted MONTHVIEW, from caldll 0291AB78/0291959C/02919E2C.
VGA logical pixels. Android font rasterization is not GDI pixel equivalence.
Native flag decoration: low 12 bits / next 12 bits / bit 24 outline.

name: WmNotesView
description:
Notes list/text client in 480-wide SDK coordinates. Owner supplies data and persistence.
Plain text only; owner supplies folder identities. RichInk drawing/recording is not implemented.

name: WmPaint
description: Synthetic presentation costs; these are not measurements of original hardware.

name: WmPalette
description:
Semantic control colors. ROM COLOR_3DFACE (index15) is #c9e7e9.
Hue follows the shared theme policy while original face saturation/value stay.

name: WmPhoneKeypad
description:
WM phone keypad in logical VGA units. The owner handles dialing and permissions.
Canvas skins approximate the captured WM614 buttons; font rasterization differs
between Android and the original device. No inferred long-press actions.

name: WmPhoneView
description:
Captured WM614 phone client; the owner supplies telephony and contact data.
No provider query, permission prompt or outgoing call belongs to this view.

name: WmPointer
description:
Opt-in relative trackpad on a logical VGA surface. No accessibility service,
global input injection or system permissions. It controls this surface only.

name: WmPopup
description:
SHBoxEx popup body; coordinates follow AYGSHELL03855938/038566D0.
Supply plain content or a WmPaint wrapper, then attach to a modal overlay.

name: WmPropertySheet
description:
Caller-owned property pages with the shared bottom tab strip. Pages stay
attached when hidden; this control owns no footer, scrolling or page state.

name: WmPwiDocument
description:
Immutable original PWI input, with text, scalar format and saved layout access for the recovered
text-only record family. Unsupported objects fail explicitly. This is not an
editor or a general PWI writer: getOriginalBytes() returns the unchanged input.
Native evidence: design/notes-pwi-stream-evidence.json and the text/edit/format native evidence files.

name: WmPwiLayout
description:
Recovered RichInk coordinate and line-placement arithmetic. Inputs are native
logical coordinates and explicit runtime metrics, never Android dp/sp. This
kernel does not measure fonts, wrap text, reflow a dirty cache or draw a view.
See design/notes-pwi-{paragraph,coordinate,line-position}-native-evidence.json.

name: WmPwiTextLayout
description:
Text-only C8994/E2984 wrapping with owner-supplied font measurement. Coordinates
are native logical units; this does not provide GDI-equivalent Android shaping.
Type3/7 objects and extended styles fail explicitly. See notes-pwi-wrap-native-evidence.json.

name: WmPwiView
description:
Read-only binary PWI text adaptation. Fresh native wrapping/coordinate kernels
use Android font measurements; this is not GDI, ink, editor or writer fidelity.
The owner supplies DPI, scale, native break profile and explicit persisted-font
mapping. No device-density inference or silent document/font fallback occurs.
Saved line caches are never used to lay out this view. Plain streams, bullets,
highlight, unknown underline variants and extended character formats are rejected.

name: WmRadioMenu
description:
Shared command/radio popup body. Row44/padding32,12/dot8 remain provisional VGA
metrics. The14px submenu mask/placement trace GWES BITMAP5 at192dpi
with default WidgSz=0; separator9px/1px rule remains an adaptation.
Selection callbacks use entry indices.

name: WmRecurrenceChoice
description:
Native appointment recurrence combo: once, weekly, monthly, yearly, edit.
Native sources: pimdlg027D50AC/027D8418/027D8578/027D86D0/027D87BC/027D9618.
Caller owns popup placement and wizard lifetime; commits must call choose().
Native closed-field case540999780 uses 027D8578; index4 loads resource4002,
the edit label. 027D8418 recognizes start-matching no-end presets, else index4.
English wording is authored; Korean labels are ROM-backed.
Geometry is inherited from WmChoice and remains provisional DLU conversion.

name: WmRecurrenceEditor
description:
Provider-free native recurrence wizard (PIMDLG20020/20200..20202).
Native pattern/order/presets are preserved; logical row and popup dimensions
remain provisional. Caller owns timezone, RRULE compatibility and saving.

name: WmRecurrenceRule
description:
Immutable recurrence pattern and range, without provider or timezone policy.
Serializes newly authored rules only; it does not parse existing RRULEs.
Timed UNTIL is caller-converted basic UTC; all-day UNTIL is a basic date.
Years0001..9999 are accepted. This RFC codec does not imply CalendarProvider
expansion support: API14 YEARLY BYSETPOS and non-Sunday weekly anchors differ.
Leap seconds are rejected. Native input limits and UI ordering are not claimed.

name: WmReminder
description:
Relative appointment reminder; no provider or scheduling policy.
Native input permits four digits, including zero. Unit changes preserve
quantity, not total minutes. Initial minute values must round-trip exactly.

name: WmResourcePack
description:
Data-only version2 ZIPs with caller-defined resource IDs. Install off the UI thread; the caller owns input.
An immutable snapshot keeps its files while a new pack is activated.
This store does not decode artwork, execute files or include vendor assets.

name: WmResources
description:
Shared local pack resolver. Prepare/install on a worker before rendering.
Missing assets use packaged defaults when available.
Independent WM applets can mirror the host's data-only snapshot on a worker.

name: WmScrollBar
description:
GWE registry metrics at 192 DPI: cxVScr=26, cyVScr=40, cyThMin=26.
GWE AE0C8/ADE0C supplies flat frames, inverted arrows and three thumb grips;
see design/scrollbar-paint.md for source and GDI raster limits.
Invisible finger margins and relative dragging deliberately
adapt the stylus-sized control for capacitive touch without widening its paint.

name: WmScrollView
description:
Shared applet scrolling: classic paint, ordinary finger swipes, larger thumb hit area.
Geometry is expressed in VGA pixels; {@link WmViewport} owns the only display scale.

name: WmSettingsView
description:
Caller-owned settings metadata and callbacks, with retained category pages.
Keys must be globally unique across categories. No settings are read or written.
Grid and caption origins model native192DPI metrics; Android caption raster remains provisional.

name: WmShell
description:
Optional launcher bridge. Appearance/menu queries are read-only; clock mode is a public cosmetic setter. Audio memory only
remembers the actual system media level, never caller-provided preferences.
No owner, messages, tasks or PIM data.
Android activities remain ordinary independent apps; WM activities opt in.

name: WmSipButton
description:
ROM icon505 and completed-UP/arrow-DOWN actions, adapted to Android IMEs.
The original shell can show SIP without an editor. Android requires a served
editor: this control is visible only while its owner contains an eligible one.
The picker is Android-owned; ordinary apps cannot switch IMEs silently.

name: WmSpeedDialView
description: Captured WM614 Speed Dial row layout. Host owns storage, editing and dialing.

name: WmStartBackground
description: Shared ROM Start texture, repeated in logical VGA coordinates in every shell.

name: WmStartMenu
description: Shared Start rows and folder navigation in logical VGA coordinates.

name: WmStatusPanel
description:
Shared live Android status body; WmPopup owns the SHBoxEx chrome.
Wide bubble/footer and volume controls follow the unscaled VGA captures.

name: WmStrings
description:
Exact authored/context keys. Never translate user/provider data or normalize keys.
Catalogs belong to each AssetManager, so an app's overrides cannot leak to another.

name: WmTabDrawable
description: Bottom property-sheet tab: selected face joins the white page, no top edge.

name: WmTabStrip
description: Shared property-sheet tabs in logical VGA; native font/DLU metrics remain provisional.

name: WmTaskEditor
description:
Task card core from PIMDLG 20007/20044. Owner saves values and supplies shell commands.
Inactive rows follow the captured VGA PIM card; ordinary date coupling follows the recovered task owner.
shortcut: recurrence and native category database services are not ported.

name: WmThreeStateCheck
description:
Stock BS_3STATE/BS_AUTO3STATE:0→1→2→0, original outlined mixed tick.
Setters do not notify the state listener; automatic user toggles do.
The inherited boolean checked value is true only for CHECKED.

name: WmTimeFormat
description: Minute captions shared by PIM editors and Calendar consumers.

name: WmTitleBar
description:
Shared logical-VGA title assembly. Data, actions and timers belong to its host.
Native shell geometry: height52, logo42x36 at x4, caption insets14/4,
tray gap4 and close width50. Narrow connection and borderless close retain
WMDroid's device-reference policies; this is not a WinCE drawing backend.

name: WmToday
description:
Shared Today presentation for local modules and provider-backed rows.
Data, permissions and actions belong to the module's host, not this layout.

name: WmTouchFeedback
description: Native handled-DOWN feedback, decoded asynchronously on the media stream.

name: WmTouchSoundOptions
description:
Supported Screen controls from shellres dialog14399; caller owns persistence.
Shared row metrics adapt the template; this is not the full Sounds CPL.

name: WmTrayClock
description:
shell32 203FC clock in VGA coordinates. The parent scales the complete title bar.
Hand tables preserve the ROM's integer arithmetic, including its negative-angle
sine behavior; see design/tray-clock-hands.json. This view owns no timer or popup.

name: WmTraySlot
description:
Shared VGA tray hit target. Artwork stays32px; connection ink is packed.
Native shell normal slots38, battery42, gap4; narrow connection is a user override.

name: WmVectorDrawable
description:
Bounded, data-only Canvas vectors for resource packs, including API14.
No SVG scripts, external URLs, embedded code or artwork constants.
The caller owns input; decode on a worker before attaching the Drawable.

name: WmViewport
description:
Shared Android surface for the ROM-based logical VGA coordinate contract.
The default logical width is480; smaller UI scales expand the logical width.
Uniform scaling fills the available physical width and height.
This is an Android adaptation, not a claim about native WinCE rendering.

name: WmVolumeFeedback
description:
VoiceBar 2655A20: Quietest at step1, SystemDefault at2..4, Loudest at5.
Default.wav is a ROM fallback: the SystemDefault runtime alias is not recovered.
Independent pools route previews to media/ring without changing global volumes.

name: WmWindow
description:
One window contract for hosted applets and independent WM-style Activities.
No inset between the 52px title, client area and 52px command bar.
The host supplies its title/tray and commands; this class owns their geometry.

name: WmWizard
description:
Retained-page wizard following PIMDLG dialog20020's cancel/back/next/finish
arrangement. Geometry projects the observed SDK emulator base units7/14 at
logical192DPI; custom fonts/OEM profiles remain adaptations.
Callers own page validation and completion. No shell footer or provider work.

name: WmYearChooser
description:
Shared editor for Calendar command69 / dialog20037 / edit21212.
The native four-character and1900..2999 rules are preserved. This embedded
control's placement and inline error are adaptations; DLU pixels are unmapped.

name: WmYearView
description:
caldll YEARVIEW: 02916AA4 layout, 02915EEC atlas, 0291640C today,
02915764 hit testing. Coordinates are native 192-DPI logical pixels.
Original atlas glyphs are retained; Android title/bubble font metrics and
SHGetMetric(12)'s unmeasured runtime border use explicit SDK adaptations.
